name: Teledyne Technologies
outlook:
What Teledyne Technologies says to expect

  • Fourth quarter and full year 2026: EPSBased on its current outlook, the company’s management believes that fourth quarter 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $5.68 to $5.83, and full year 2026 GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $21.71 to $21.87. The company’s management further believes that fourth quarter 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $6.60 to $6.70, and full year 2026 non-GAAP diluted earnings per share will be in the range of $25.40 to $25.50.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 21, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
